text:
maya: Quick off-topic poll — what's a tiny ~90-second thing that reliably makes your day better? not big habits, tiny pleasures. 

sam: Freshly grinding coffee. the smell is immediate :coffee:

noah: Closing my laptop and standing up to stretch. feels like a reset button.

aline: Opening a window and letting real air in. bonus if there's a bird.

maya: Love that. small tactile things hit different.

harry: 30 seconds of mindful breathing between meetings. cringe but it works. :sweat_smile:

sara: Sending a quick gif to a friend. instant mood boost. :heart:

sam: Also, unfittingly specific: re-flipping a sticky page of a notebook. tiny victory.

noah: dev-bot: build passed on main — tiny celebratory hop. (jk) :robot_face:

aline: `dev-bot` messages are the new office tambourine.

maya: Okay this is staying on my radar. I'm going to try one new tiny ritual for a week. who wants to share results Friday?

sam: I'm in. reporting 90-second findings.

harry: I'll do breathing challenge. will report with emoji stats.

sara: I'm doomed to gifs. will share best one-liner.

noah: Also surprising entry: rubbing my temples for exactly 60 seconds after long calls. instant clarity.

aline: vote: window > breathing > gif for most universal? :ballot_box_with_check:

maya: poll-ish consensus noted. thanks team for the brain-refresh ideas :sparkles:

sam: 1-line follow-up — anyone have a 90-sec playlist rec? gotta curate quick reset music.

harry: 3 songs, 90 seconds each. perfect. i'll DM a weird mix.

maya: perfect — I'll make a little doc of everyone's tiny rituals and drop it in #random later. feel free to add yours. :grin:
